items.title: 14.13 Data ka tajziya aur hawa ke mayar ki tashreeh (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 14.13, printed page 317.

blocks.text: Jama kiya gaya data analyse kiya jata hai taake pata chale ke hypothesis sach hai ya ghalat. Analysis ke nataij ki tashreeh (interpretation, yani matlab samajhna) ki jati hai aur nateeja nikala jata hai.

Air quality ke data ka analysis aur tashreeh in baaton par mushtamil hai: mukhtalif pollutants ki concentration samajhna, waqt ke saath rujhan (trends) pehchanna, aur yeh dekhna ke awam ki sehat aur environmental policy ke liye is ka kya matlab hai. (Kitab yahan 'General approach ... are follows' likhti hai lekin us ke baad koi list nahi chhapi.)
Ehtiyat se experiment design kar ke, aur data jama aur analyse kar ke, air quality ki hypothesis test ki ja sakti hai aur air quality behtar karne ki strategies (hikmat-e-amli) banai ja sakti hain.

blocks.prompt: Ek shehr mein PM2.5 ki reading ek hi din subah 8 baje 180 aur dopahar 2 baje 60 hai. In numbers ka kya matlab hai?
blocks.explanation: Subah ki 180 sab ke liye unhealthy hai, dopahar ki 60 moderate. Subah ka peak rush hour traffic aur raat ki garam hawa ki layer (inversion) ki taraf ishara karta hai jo zarron ko rok kar rakhti hai jab tak dhoop hawa ko garam kar ke mila na de. Policy ke liye: subah ka traffic emission kam karna, aur hassas logon ko subah sawere bahar ki activity se bachne ki hidayat dena.

items: Data analyse karein, waqt ke saath trends pehchanein, sehat aur policy ke liye matlab samjhein, hypothesis ka faisla karein aur air quality behtar karne ki strategies banayein.
